descriptor_refs: appropriate level of closeness to or distance from audience
strong sense of audience; writer seems aware of reader and how to communicate effectively
reader may discern writer behind words and feel sense of interaction
topic has come to life; shows originality, liveliness, honesty, conviction, excitement, humor, or suspense
justification: The evidence demonstrates consistent audience awareness (e.g., 'I wanted this team to like me' [span-ext-3c6d6792d6e7], 'enjoying the sport as well as the people' [span-ext-6a6c55e35c11]), deep commitment to the topic (e.g., 'Softball has to be one of the single most greatest sports alive' [span-ext-a10eff501df3], 'friendships... that I never would have discovered' [span-ext-df61729620ec]), and expressive language throughout (e.g., vivid physical descriptions of nervousness [span-ext-80350409f9f2, span-ext-eef759e1da06], emotional reflections on memories [span-ext-1356335d1d71]). This meets the Score 5 threshold of sustained voice with intentional audience awareness and liveliness that stands out consistently across multiple facets.
